αἰνοτάτη: αἰνός — dread, terrible; superl. fem. nom. sg., used as a vocative in address: ’most dreadful one’
αὐτὰς: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. acc. pl.: ’themselves’
βαλέω: βάλλω — throw, cast, hurl; fut. 1 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic βαλῶ): ’I will throw’
βιώτω: βιόω — live; aor. imper. 3 sg. act. (aor. ἐβίων): ’let him live’
βωμοῖσι: βωμός — pedestal, raised base (usually ’altar’); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
γλαυκῶπι: γλαυκῶπις — gleaming-eyed (or ’owl-eyed’; sense uncertain), epithet of Athena; fem. voc. sg.
γυιώσειν: γυιόω — lame, cripple (γυῖον ’limb’); fut. inf. act., after a verb of threatening: ’to lame’
γυιώσω: γυιόω — lame, cripple (γυῖον ’limb’); fut. 1 sg. act.: ’I will lame’
δίωκε: διώκω — drive on, chase, pursue; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐδίωκε): ’drove on’
δεκάτους: δέκατος — tenth; masc. acc. pl., agreeing with ἐνιαυτούς
δικαζέτω: δικάζω — give judgment, judge; pres. imper. 3 sg. act., + dat.: ’let him judge’
θην: θήν — surely, I warrant, to be sure; emphatic particle
θρόνον: θρόνος — chair, seat of honour; masc. acc. sg.
θώκους: θῶκος — seat; masc. acc. pl.: ’seats’ (of the gods in assembly)
κάθιζον: καθίζω — sit down, take a seat; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἐκάθιζον): ’were sitting’
κάμετόν: κάμνω — toil, grow weary (+ part.: ’tire of doing’); aor. 2 dual, unaugmented (= Attic ἐκάμετον); accent shifted before enclitic γε
κάπῃσιν: κάπη — manger, feeding-trough; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
κατέδησαν: καταδέω — bind, tether, fasten down; aor. 3 pl., augmented (κατα- + ἔδησαν, elided to κατέδησαν): ’they tethered’
κλισμοῖσι: κλισμός — reclining chair, seat; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
κύον: κύων — dog; masc./fem. voc. sg., a term of abuse
λῖτα: λίς — smooth linen cloth; acc. sg.
μάρπτῃσι: μάρπτω — seize, catch; pres. subj. 3 sg. act., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -ῃ), in a general relative clause with κεν: ’whatever seizes’
μάχηαι: μάχομαι — fight; pres. subj. 2 sg. mid., epic -ηαι (= Attic -ῃ), + dat., in a temporal clause with ἂν: ’when you fight’
μέματον: μέμαα (μάομαι) — strive, be eager, rush; perf. with pres. sense, 2 dual (= Attic μεμάτον, no Attic pres.): ’you two are rushing’
μέρμερα: μέρμερος — grievous, baneful, causing care (sense uncertain); neut. nom./acc. pl., agreeing with ἔργα
μίγδ: μίγδα — mingled, in company with; adv. + dat., elided (μίγδ’ = μίγδα): ’mixed among’
νεμεσίζεται: νεμεσίζομαι — feel indignation, be ashamed; pres. 3 sg., + dat.: ’is indignant at’
νεμεσίζομαι: νεμεσίζομαι — feel righteous indignation, resent; pres. 1 sg., + dat.: ’resent’
οἶαι: οἶος — alone, only; fem. nom. pl. (= Attic μόναι), agreeing with αἳ
πάντως: πάντως — altogether, certainly, in every way; adv.
πελεμίζετ: πελεμίζω — shake, make tremble; impf. 3 sg. pass., elided (πελεμίζετ’ = πελεμίζετο), unaugmented: ’was shaken’
περιτελλομένους: περιτέλλομαι — revolve, come round (of years); pres. part. mid. masc. acc. pl., agreeing with ἐνιαυτούς
πληγέντε: πλήσσω — strike; aor. part. pass. nom. dual (-έντε, masc. form used for two goddesses): ’the two being struck’
πολέμοιό: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου); accent added before enclitic τε
πολυπτύχου: πολύπτυχος — many-folded, with many ridges and glens; masc. gen. sg., epithet of Olympus
πρώτῃσιν: πρῶτος — first; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic πρώταις)
πτολεμίζειν: πτολεμίζω — make war, fight; pres. inf. act., epic π-τ form (= Attic πολεμίζειν)
πτόλεμον: πτόλεμος — war, battle; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic πόλεμος); goal of motion with the -δε ’to’ that follows
συνοισόμεθα: συμφέρω — bring together; mid. come together, clash; fut. 1 pl. mid., from the stem οἰσ- of φέρω: ’we shall clash’
ταχεῖα: ταχύς — swift, fleet; fem. voc. sg., in address: ’swift one’
τελέει: τελέω — accomplish, complete, fulfill; fut. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic τελεῖ)
τετίησθον: τετίημαι — be distressed, be downcast (perf. with pres. sense; stem uncertain); 2 dual: ’you two are dejected’
τετιημέναι: τετίημαι — be distressed, be downcast (perf. with pres. sense; stem uncertain); perf. part. mid. fem. nom. pl.: ’distressed’
τολμήσεις: τολμάω — dare, have the heart; fut. 2 sg. act., + inf.: ’you will dare’
τοῖσίν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl.; also relative: ’against whom’ (accented τοῖσίν before the enclitic τε)
τρέπε: τρέπω — turn, turn back; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’turn!’ · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔτρεπε): ’turned’
τρέψειαν: τρέπω — turn, turn aside; aor. opt. 3 pl. act. (-ειαν), with ἄν, potential: ’could turn’
τύχῃ: τυγχάνω — hit, light upon, happen; aor. subj. 3 sg. (aor. ἔτυχον), in a general relative clause with κε: ’whichever chances’
φωνήσασα: φωνέω — speak, utter one’s voice; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having spoken’
χολοῦμαι: χολόομαι — be angry, be enraged; pres. 1 sg. mid. dep. (contracted -οῦμαι)
χολοῦται: χολόομαι — be angry, be enraged; pres. 3 sg. mid. dep. (contracted -οῦται)
χρυσέοισιν: χρύσεος — golden; masc. dat. pl., epic uncontracted -έοισιν (= Attic χρυσοῖς)
χρυσόπτερον: χρυσόπτερος — gold-winged; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with Ἶριν
χώσατ: χώομαι — be incensed, be angry; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (χώσατ’ = χώσατο; = Attic ἐχώσατο): ’was incensed’
ἀγγελέουσα: ἀγγέλλω — bring news, announce; fut. part. act. fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀγγελοῦσα), of purpose: ’to bring news’
ἀγγελέουσαν: ἀγγέλλω — bring news, announce; fut. part. act. fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀγγελοῦσαν), of purpose: ’to bring news’
ἀδεὲς: ἀδεής — fearless, reckless, shameless (ἀ- + δέος ’fear’); fem. voc. sg. (or adverbial neut. acc.; the form allows both), in address; accent grave before the next word
ἀελλόπος: ἀελλόπος — storm-footed, swift as a gale (ἄελλα + πούς); fem. nom. sg., epithet of Iris
ἀεῖραι: αἴρω — lift, raise; aor. inf. act., epic ἀεῖραι (= Attic ἆραι): ’to raise’
ἀμβροσίῃσι: ἀμβρόσιος — immortal, divine, ambrosial; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
ἀντομένη: ἀντάομαι (ἄντομαι) — meet, encounter; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg., epic: ’meeting’
ἀπαλθήσεσθον: ἀπαλθήσκομαι — be healed, recover; fut. 2 dual mid.: ’you two will be healed’
ἀποφθίσθω: ἀποφθίνω — perish, die away; aor. imper. 3 sg. mid.: ’let him perish’
ἃ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; neut. acc. pl.: ’his own’ (τὰ ἃ φρονέων ’thinking his own thoughts’)
ἄαπτοι: ἄαπτος — irresistible, invincible (sense and origin uncertain); fem. nom. pl., agreeing with χεῖρες
ἄξειν: ἄγνυμι — break, break to pieces; fut. inf. act., in tmesis with κατά (κατὰ … ἄξειν = κατάξειν): ’to break down’
ἐάᾳ: ἐάω — let, allow; pres. 3 sg. act., epic diectasis (= Attic ἐᾷ): ’allows’
ἐΰτροχον: ἐΰτροχος — well-rolling, with good wheels (Attic εὔτροχος); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἅρμα
ἐνικλᾶν: ἐνικλάω — thwart, cross, break in upon (sense uncertain); pres. inf. act., contracted, complementary inf. after ἔωθα: ’to thwart’
ἐννοσίγαιος: ἐννοσίγαιος — ’earth-shaker’, epithet/name of Poseidon (built on γαῖα, distinct from ἐνοσίχθων built on χθών); masc. nom. sg.
ἐνώπια: ἐνώπια — the inner wall-faces of the porch (fixed architectural term); neut. acc. pl. · also the inner wall-faces of a hall: ’inner walls’ (πρὸς ἐνώπια παμφανόωντα ’against the shining inner walls’)
ἐξίκετο: ἐξικνέομαι — arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg. mid., + acc.
ἐπαμυνέμεν: ἐπαμύνω — come to the defence of (+ dat.); pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἐπαμύνειν)
ἐπιεικές: ἐπιεικής — fitting, suitable, proper; neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’as is fitting’
ἐῶ: ἐάω — let, allow; pres. 1 sg. act., contracted (ἐάω → ἐῶ), + acc. and inf.: ’I allow’
ἔθεσθε: τίθημι — put, place; mid. take up, conceive; aor. 2 pl. mid. (aor. ἐθέμην): κότον ἔθεσθε ’you conceived resentment’
ἔωθεν: ἔωθα (εἴωθα) — be accustomed; perf. 3 sg. act. with pres. sense, movable -ν (= Attic εἴωθε), + inf.: ’is accustomed’
ἠπείλησε: ἀπειλέω — threaten (+ dat., + inf.); aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’threatened’
ἰδεῖν: ὁράω (aor. εἶδον) — see; aor. inf. act.: ’to see’
ἰδῇ: ὁράω (aor. εἶδον) — see; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’may see’
ἰδῇς: ὁράω (aor. εἶδον) — see; aor. subj. 2 sg. act., in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’you may see’
ἵκεσθον: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at; 2 dual mid., short-vowel form after ἄν, ambiguous (aor. subj. or past form); sense here past: ’you two would have come’
ἶρι: Ἶρις — Iris, messenger of the gods; fem. voc. sg.
ἶριν: Ἶρις — Iris, messenger of the gods; fem. acc. sg.
ὀλλῦσαι: ὄλλυμι — destroy, kill; pres. part. act. fem. nom. pl. (for two subjects), supplementary after κάμνω: ’destroying’
ὄλυμπος: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus, mountain home of the gods; masc. nom. sg.
ὑμετέρων: ὑμέτερος — your (pl.), yours; masc. gen. pl.

__broaden__.πυκινὸν: πυκινός — thick, close-set, solid; masc. acc. sg.: ’solid’ · also masc. acc. sg., of a plot: ’close-woven, cunning’ (πυκινὸν δόλον ’a cunning trap’) · also neut. acc. sg., of a word: ’shrewd’ (πυκινὸν ἔπος ’a shrewd word’) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with νέφος: ’dense’ (πυκινὸν νέφος ’dense cloud’)
__broaden__.στῆθος: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’breast’ (Ἥρῃ … στῆθος ’Hera’s breast’)
__broaden__.τετελεσμένον: τελέω — bring to pass, fulfil; perf. pass. part. neut. nom. sg., periphrastic with ἔσται: ’shall stand fulfilled’ · also perf. pass. part. neut. nom. sg., periphrastic with ἦεν: ’would have been fulfilled’
__broaden__.τοῖσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’with them’ · also masc. dat. pl., ’among them, to them’ (τοῖσιν … μετέφη ’spoke among them’) · also relative, masc. dat. pl.: ’against whom’ (τοῖσιν κότον ἔθεσθε ’against whom you conceived resentment’)
__broaden__.τόσον: τόσος — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’only so far’ · also correlative with ὅσον, neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’so loudly, so much’ · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial, with οὔ τι: ’so much’ (οὔ τι τόσον ’not so much’)
__broaden__.ἐμόν: ἐμός — my, mine; neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκνον · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with θυμόν: ’my (heart)’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with μένος: ’my (might)’
__broaden__.ἐφ: ἐπί (elided ἐφ’ before a rough breathing) — on, upon, over; + dat. ’on’ · also + acc., ’to, towards’ · also in ὅσσον ἐφ’ …, ἐπί of unclear attachment: ’(lying) on, at’ · also + dat., ’against’ (Τρωσὶν ἐφ’ ἱπποδάμοισιν ’against the Trojans’) · also + gen., ’by oneself’ (ἐφ’ ὑμείων ’by yourselves, apart’) · also + gen., ’upon’ (ἐφ’ ὑμετέρων ὀχέων ’upon your chariot’)
__broaden__.ἔννεπε: ἐννέπω — tell of, relate, speak; pres. imper. 2 sg. · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔνεπε): ’told, spoke’
__broaden__.ἕλκε: ἕλκω — drag, pull; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= εἷλκε): ’was dragging’ · also ἕλκος — wound, sore; neut. acc. pl. ἕλκεα, elided (ἕλκε’ = ἕλκεα), uncontracted (= Attic ἕλκη): ’wounds’
__broaden__.ἄξω: ἄγω — lead, take; fut. 1 sg.: ’I will take’ · also ἄγνυμι — break, break to pieces; fut. 1 sg., in tmesis with κατά (κατὰ … ἄξω = κατάξω): ’I will break down’
